newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: South Korean Cheiljedang in video sales JV with Disney.
newsitem.headline: South Korean Cheiljedang in video sales JV with Disney.

text.p: South Korea's Cheiljedang Group said on Tuesday it would enter a video distribution venture in South Korea with Walt Disney Korea, a unit of Walt Disney Co.
Cheiljedang said in a statement they planned to start selling Walt Disney's videos through supermarkets next week.
It said this is the first time videos will be sold in the nation's supermarkets.
Cheiljedang plans to initially distribute 37 different Walt Disney's videos such as the Lion King, Aladdin and Pocahontas and then expand the selection to locally-made videos from next year.
